headline: At 2k steps, circuit and GIN are statistically tied on held-out strict compliance (~1%). Only Loaded_Line shows nonzero strict transfer (circuit 6.7% vs gin 6.0%). All-Pass prior pass is fixed (~96–99%) but strict compliance remains 0. Hard folds Reflection_Type and VM stay prior-limited. Circuit does not yet beat GIN on the acceptance criterion; longer training and/or coupled actions + SKY130-realizable grammar are the next levers.
